title: Savings
intro: The savings assistant reads the purchase history, the agreed prices and the purchasing queue, and shows where the organization could buy for less. Every amount is calculated from the data in BCS, never estimated by AI.
forbidden: This page is for people who can see every purchase order and request of the organization (procurement, finance, executives and auditors), because past prices come from every PO.

summary.label: Savings summary
summary.total: At comparable prices, {amount} baht less in all
summary.totalNote: A line found by more than one check counts its largest amount once · prices before VAT · services are left out, as they are often priced per job of a different scope
summary.none: No amount to save found yet

empty.title: No savings found yet
empty.hint: The assistant reads the requests waiting for approval and the purchasing queue each time this page opens. A request priced above past purchases or an agreed price about to end shows here.
empty.filtered: Nothing of this kind right now

amount.PRICE_ABOVE_HISTORY: At the median price, {amount} baht less
amount.OFF_AGREEMENT: At the agreed price, {amount} baht less
amount.SAME_ITEM_DEPARTMENTS: All at the lowest price, {amount} baht less

PRICE_ABOVE_HISTORY.title: {number} line {line} {description} is {pct} above past prices
PRICE_ABOVE_HISTORY.why: The median of {count} POs in {days} days is {reference} baht per {uom} · this request asks {price} baht per {uom} for {quantity}

OFF_AGREEMENT.title: {number} line {line} {item} is off the agreed price
OFF_AGREEMENT.why: The lowest agreed price in effect today is {agreed} baht per {uom} · this line asks {price} baht per {uom} for {quantity} {supplier}
OFF_AGREEMENT.evidence: Agreed prices of this item in effect today

SAME_ITEM_DEPARTMENTS.title: {description} waits for a PO from {departments} departments, delivered to one place
SAME_ITEM_DEPARTMENTS.why: {lines} lines at different prices; the lowest is {lowest} baht per {uom} · bought together at this price they fit one PO

AGREEMENT_EXPIRING.title: The agreed price of {item} from {supplier} holds {days} more days
AGREEMENT_EXPIRING.why: In effect until {lastDay} at {price} baht · in the last {window} days {spent} baht was bought at this price on {count} PO lines · renew or negotiate before it ends

evidence.none: Nothing was bought at this price in this period
